From formula to dispatch

Formulate

Blended to a specification.

Base oils and additives are formulated and checked against viscosity and thermal-stability targets before a grade is approved.

Test

Proven in the laboratory.

Samples are tested on laboratory instruments, and a batch is released to filling only when it meets its specification.

Fill

Filled the same way, every time.

Automated filling heads dose each bottle consistently before it is capped and labelled.

Ship

Stocked and dispatched.

Drums and packs are staged and dispatched to workshops, depots and distributors on agreed schedules.

Common questions.

What is DEF (AdBlue)?

Diesel exhaust fluid is a 32.5% urea solution in demineralised water, injected into the exhaust of SCR diesel engines to cut nitrogen oxide emissions. Vehicles with SCR need it to run correctly.

How do I choose an engine oil grade?

Start with your vehicle manual for the viscosity grade and approval it asks for. Our team can match a PureLub grade to it.

Do you supply in bulk?

Yes. Pack sizes, bulk and fleet supply are available on request, so tell us the product and monthly quantity.

Can I get a data sheet before I order?

Yes. Ask for the technical or safety data sheet of any grade through the enquiry form.

How quickly can you deliver?

Delivery times depend on product and location. Send an enquiry and we’ll confirm a schedule.
